positions.notes: Stage 1 translator: en «Online Stores» / ar «المتاجر» (the Arabic bar name is the short genus; en makes «online» explicit). 网店 = 网上商店, the everyday mainland word for an online shop (淘宝网店). It is the term of the destination page itself: h1 «哈萨本地特产网店名录», lead «{n} 家哈萨网店尽收一处», FAQ «许多网店和工厂» (TM). Stage 2 editor: two characters, matches the short bar names 景点 · 路线 · 活动 · 住宿 · 地图; 店铺 (used inside the page for cards: 访问店铺 · 筛选店铺) is rejected for the bar because without 网 it reads as physical shops — the souq is already 传统市集 in the bar. 网上商店 rejected as longer with no gain. Stage 3 localizer: natural for a mainland traveller; no 购物 (would promise a shopping guide). Stage 4 benchmarker: no proper name, no termbase entry needed beyond the page's own usage; VisitSaudi zh uses 购物 for shopping sections (different concept, not used). Stage 5 proofreader: simplified only, no punctuation, no Latin.
